rows.name: Second night of a back-to-back
rows.desc: His team also played yesterday. Theory: tired legs, fewer shots.

rows.name: Hot hand
rows.desc: His last five games averaged at least one shot more than his season. Theory: ride the streak.

rows.name: Cold spell
rows.desc: His last five games averaged at least one shot fewer than his season. Theory: fade him (or: due to bounce back).

rows.name: Shut out last game
rows.desc: He had zero shots last game. Theory: he bounces back.

rows.name: Coming off a big night
rows.desc: He had five or more shots last game. Theory: it carries over.

rows.name: On the road
rows.desc: Away game. Theory: road skaters shoot less than projected, even after the model's home adjustment.
